about: La Porte County weather radio for laporteweathernow.com (Alerts page). Official NWS information read by an open-source voice (Kokoro-82M, af_heart). Replaced whenever the broadcast changes.

segments.title: Welcome
text: Good morning, friends, and thanks for tuning in. This is the La Porte Weather Now weather radio for La Porte County, Indiana. Here's the latest as of 11:32 a.m., Saturday, November 28.

segments.title: Alerts
text: Good news first: there are no watches, warnings or advisories for La Porte County right now.

segments.title: Right now
text: At 10:35 a.m., at the La Porte airport, it's 43 degrees under mostly clear skies. The wind is from the south-southwest at 13 mph.

segments.title: Forecast
text: Now, here's your forecast from the National Weather Service.
This afternoon: Sunny, with a high near 49. Southwest wind 10 to 15 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph.
Tonight: Rain likely after 2 a.m. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 38. Southwest wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 60%.
Sunday: Rain. Cloudy, with a high near 44. East wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%. New rainfall amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible.

Looking further ahead. Sunday night: Light rain then mostly cloudy, low around 32, with a 80% chance of rain. Monday: Mostly sunny, high near 38. Monday night: Partly cloudy, low around 26. Tuesday: Partly sunny, high near 43.

segments.title: Daily Scoop
text: And here's today's Daily Scoop: Mostly sunny near 49; rain likely Sunday.

A chance of showers, then mostly sunny today, high near 49; mostly cloudy, then a chance of light rain (40%) tonight, low around 36; then rain likely Sunday, with no watches, warnings or advisories for La Porte County.
You can read the whole Scoop on our website.

segments.title: Sign-off
text: That's the latest from La Porte Weather Now, and thanks for listening. If a warning is issued, act on it right away, and keep your phone's emergency alerts turned on. I hope everyone has a safe and happy holiday. Take care of each other, and stay safe, La Porte County.
